detail.note: The sampled field is G(x)/std(x): the truncated KL field normalized to unit pointwise variance. Its covariance is the truncated CORRELATION, not sigma^2*exp(-r^2/2l^2); sigma cancels identically. max_abs_gap_truncated_vs_target_kernel is the cost of truncating at variance_explained and must be reported as a modelling approximation.

gates.name: gradient_fd
gates.message: DEGENERATE: all 4 samples returned identical compliance (sigma_C=0), so the gradient cannot be verified. The eta perturbation had no effect on the design at all. Almost always this is PROJECTION SATURATION: tanh(beta*(rho_tilde - eta)) is +/-1 to machine precision once |rho_tilde - eta| exceeds ~19/beta = 0.594, so a design whose filtered density sits outside [-0.344, 1.34] responds to no eta draw whatsoever. Check (a) that validation.fd_design_blend puts the design inside the eta band, and (b) that the mesh RESOLVES the filter: at R/h < 1 the filtered field jumps between 0 and 1 within a single element, leaving no interface band for eta to act on, which makes the whole eta model degenerate on that mesh -- not just this gate.
